description: Download metadata, video, audio, or captions for YouTube content you own or are authorized to download.

allow4K.description: Enable 1440p/2160p SDR downloads. These are capped at 10 minutes and 1000 MB and may use MKV with VP9/AV1 because YouTube rarely serves H.264 above 1080p.
allow4K.title: Allow 4K

audioFormat.description: Source audio passthrough format used when audioOnly is enabled.
audioFormat.title: Audio Format

audioOnly.description: Download the source audio track without video and without re-encoding.
audioOnly.title: Audio Only

channelUrls.description: YouTube channel URLs, @handles, or UC channel IDs. The Videos tab is used.
channelUrls.title: Channel URLs

container.description: Auto uses MP4 H.264/AAC when available and MKV for VP9/AV1. Explicit MP4 never relabels AV1/Opus content as MP4; if no compatible stream exists the video gets a failure row.
container.title: Container

cookies.description: Optional cookies.txt content for age-restricted or members-only videos. Public videos work without cookies.
cookies.title: Cookies (Netscape format)

downloadSubtitles.description: Fetch available manual or automatic captions for the requested languages.
downloadSubtitles.title: Download Subtitles

includeTranscript.description: Add a plain-text transcript from the first requested caption track.
includeTranscript.title: Include Transcript Text

kvsName.description: Named key-value store name when storage=named_kvs. Defaults to youtube-downloader.
kvsName.title: KVS Name

maxMB.description: Reject oversized downloads. Values above 500 are only used for 4K opt-in downloads, which are capped at 1000 MB.
maxMB.title: Max MB Per Video

maxMinutes.description: Reject a video before download when its duration exceeds this cap. 4K opt-in downloads are additionally capped at 10 minutes.
maxMinutes.title: Max Minutes Per Video

maxVideos.description: Total videos processed across all inputs.
maxVideos.title: Max Videos

mode.description: What to return: metadata only, media files, or caption files without media.
mode.title: Mode

playlistUrls.description: YouTube playlist URLs. Videos are expanded up to maxVideos in total.
playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Metadata and player extraction use this connection; media bytes are downloaded directly.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

s3AccessKeyId.description: Optional access key ID when storage=s3.
s3AccessKeyId.title: S3 Access Key ID

s3Endpoint.description: Custom endpoint for S3-compatible storage such as Cloudflare R2.
s3Endpoint.title: S3 Endpoint

s3PublicBaseUrl.description: Optional public bucket URL. When set, files use public URLs instead of expiring presigned URLs.
s3PublicBaseUrl.title: S3 Public Base URL

s3Region.description: Region for S3 or S3-compatible storage.
s3Region.title: S3 Region

s3SecretAccessKey.description: Optional secret access key when storage=s3.
s3SecretAccessKey.title: S3 Secret Access Key

searchQueries.description: YouTube search phrases. Each query resolves public results up to maxVideos in total.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

storage.description: Where downloaded files are written. Named KVS persists while the store exists; ephemeral KVS follows your Apify account retention.
storage.title: Storage

storageRetentionDays.description: Signed-link lifetime for S3/R2 storage (1-7 days). KVS retention is controlled by your Apify account.
storageRetentionDays.title: Storage Retention Days

subtitleLanguages.description: Caption language codes to request. Only tracks that already exist on the video are used; translations are not promised.
subtitleLanguages.title: Subtitle Languages

videoQuality.description: SDR target quality. 360p-1080p prefer H.264/AAC MP4. 1440p and 2160p require allow4K and are delivered with their real codec and container.
videoQuality.title: Video Quality

videoUrls.description: Direct YouTube video, Shorts, live-replay, or youtu.be URLs, or 11-character video IDs.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs

title: YouTube Video Downloader Input
